name: rosetta-walsh-matrix
code:
use default

bits_set(value: int) -> int =>
    if value == 0 then
        0
    else
        value % 2 + bits_set(value / 2)
    fi

walsh(order: int) -> Pipe[string] =>
    (0..order)
        |> map(row => (0..order)
            |> map(column =>
                if bits_set(row & column) % 2 == 0 then " 1" else "-1" fi)
            |> join(" "))

for order in [2, 4, 8] do
    write_line("W({order}):")

    walsh(order) |> each(row => write_line(row))

    write_line("")
od
